parameters.name: CenId
parameters.description: The ID of the Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The number of the page to return. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: **1** to **50**. Default value: **10**.

parameters.name: VbrInstanceOwnerId
parameters.description: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account that owns the VBRs.

parameters.name: VbrInstanceRegionId
parameters.description:
The ID of the region where the VBRs are deployed.

You can call the [DescribeChildInstanceRegions](~~132080~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cbn describe-cen-vbr-health-check --cen-id cen-6hpdgj7ni6pz1k0000 --vbr-instance-region-id cn-hangzhou --vbr-instance-id vbr-bp1kznorjeembsuhl0000 --vbr-instance-owner-id 1250123456123456 --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --region cn-hangzhou
